question: How do I add Intercom to my Fern Docs?
ground_truth: To add Intercom to your Fern Docs, you need to get your Intercom app_id (workspace ID) from Settings > Workspace > General in your Intercom account, then add it to your docs.yml file under the analytics section with the configuration: analytics: intercom: app-id: ${{INTERCOM_APP_ID}}. You can also optionally configure a custom Intercom endpoint.

metadata.cited_context: To add Intercom to your Docs, you need to your Intercom `app_id`, also known as the Intercom workspace ID. This is a unique code assigned to your app when you create it in Intercom. Your app ID is available under [Settings > Workspace > General](https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/_/settings/workspace/general) in the "Workspace name & time zone" tab. In your `docs.yml` file, add your Intercom config: ```yaml analytics: intercom: app-id: ${{INTERCOM_APP_ID}} # reads your org id from environment variables # Optional endpoint: ${{INTERCOM_ENDPOINT}} # e.g. https://intercom.custom-instance.com ```
